# S256 — Gate: a report path it can write, and a resumed gate re-reads the tree

*Proposed.* A read-only role (the gate first) is told the one report hand-back it can really do, and the shape check accepts the owner question block that the role prompt's own example teaches. A role that ork resumes is told that the tree may have changed and to read `git status` and the diff again before it judges. The owner can send a note with `ork retry` to a run that is paused with no question. The design is open: see `Open owner questions`; ask the owner before the relay starts. The names below (`## Resumed session`, `pending.note`, `ork retry RUN [TEXT]`) are *proposed* and part of the questions.

**Findings:** Wave 6, 2026-11-02 (friction F38, F39): the Opus gate ran in plan mode on S213 and could not write gate-N.md, so it reported in chat; the shape check rejected a fenced Owner needed block until the owner-side retry. After the owner-run fixes, ork retry resumed the recorded gate session, which re-reported the old FAIL and asked the same question until an answer pointed it at the new tree. Needed: the gate's permission mode lets it write its report file (or the shape check reads the chat report), and a resumed gate brief says to re-read git status and the diff before it judges. Related: S204 (gate close timing), S253 (S213 later notes). · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

Q2 and Q3 accepted: every resumed round gets the fixed Resumed session section (re-run git status and git diff, plus ork's git status --porcelain), and ork retry RUN [TEXT] delivers TEXT as an owner note. Q4 keep adj 26 (resume else fresh); no fresh-session change. All remaining recommendations in Open owner questions accepted as written. Land after S237 (same Retry lines) or rebase on it. adj keys left for the owner's later pass.

## Why

Wave 6 (2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03, friction F38 and F39 in the filed findings) showed four faults. (1) The Opus gate on S213 and S235 ran in plan mode, could not write its `gate-N.md` report, and reported in chat ("Plan mode is on in this session and only allows writing the plan file"); the shape check then refused a fenced Owner needed block. (2) After the owner fixed the tree, `ork retry` resumed the recorded gate session, which re-reported the old FAIL until an answer pointed it at the new tree. (3) The S72 Sonnet implementer, resumed the same way, reported "no fixture file changed" after fixtures had been added. (4) `ork answer` and `ork fix` are refused for a run paused on a shape error, so no text can reach that session. What the code at HEAD of main shows (read 2026-11-03):

- Every read-only role cannot write its report path. `ResolvePermission` gives the reviewer, the gate, the architect, the UI pass and the spec check `Permission{ReadOnly: true}` (`internal/engine/perm.go:38-57`). The Claude adapter then passes `--permission-mode plan` (`internal/agent/claude/args.go:45-46`). Codex gets `-s read-only` and no `--add-dir` (`internal/agent/codex/codex.go:53-56`, `:74`, `:86`). The report path is in the run directory under `~/.local/state/ork/runs/` (`docs/design.md:741-742`; `round.go:235`), outside the worktree. The plan mode probe shows Claude saying plan mode is on and saving a plan under `~/.claude/plans` (`testdata/vendors/claude/05-plan-mode-edit.stdout`; `docs/design.md:1083-1087`).
- Yet every prompt says to write the report file first and to use the final message only if that fails (`internal/roles/prompts/gate.md:110-111`, `internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md:132-133`), and the brief prints `Your report path:` for every role (`internal/engine/brief.go:91`). The engine reads the file, else the vendor's final result text, and saves that text to the report path (`readReport`, `internal/engine/round.go:574-593`). That fallback is decided (adj 27, `role.report-io`: exit-and-file, "fallback to the vendor JSON result"). So for a read-only role the chat reply is not a fallback; it is the only route, and the prompt sends the role to try a write that must fail first.
- The fence. The gate prompt shows the structured question inside a ```` ```text ```` fence (`gate.md:94-101`). `parseOwnerQuestion` keeps every non-blank line from `Question:` on (`internal/engine/report.go:181-199`), so a copied closing fence line after `Recommend:` becomes the last line, `recommendLine` does not match it, and the round pauses with "Owner needed requires Question: title, Options: ... and Recommend: N - reason" (`report.go:201-228`). This is the only fence-related refusal in `CheckReport`. That S213's report held exactly this was not read (the run directory is outside the workspace).
- Resume. The gate resumes the newest gate or reviewer session of the same vendor and model on every gate round (`internal/engine/states.go:530-531`; `latestSession`, `round.go:47-56`), and the implementer always resumes its own (`states.go:146`). A question or shape pause also resumes the role's own session (`round.go:251-255`). This is decided (adj 26, `role.resume`: resume-else-fresh). Earlier reports go only into a fresh brief (`round.go:285-287`). A retry of a shape pause adds only `## Report shape`: "Write the report again so that it has the shape the prompt asks for, and exit." (`pendingSection`, `round.go:135-136`). Nothing in a resumed brief says the tree may have changed, so a resumed gate that is asked to write its report again rewrites the report it already holds. That matches (2) and (3).
- No text for a paused run without a question. `Engine.Answer` needs a pending question (`internal/engine/engine.go:433-435`), and the daemon answers "has no pending question; use ork retry" (`internal/daemon/runs.go:981-985`). `Engine.Fix` needs awaiting-approval (`internal/engine/approval.go:172-174`). `Engine.Retry` takes no text (`engine.go:463-498`), `run.retry` passes none (`runs.go:1005-1016`), and the CLI takes exactly one positional for retry (`internal/cli/run.go:221-233`; `TestRetryTakesOneRun`, `internal/cli/retry_test.go:37`). The refusals are in `.scratch/v11/answer-S72.out` and `.scratch/v11/fix-S72.out`.

Overlap:

- S237 (open) changes `ownerRunReply`, `Answer` and `Retry` (an applied hook and `no_wait`) and the CLI `ownerCommand` for answer and retry. The retry note here touches the same lines: land after S237, or rebase on it.
- S243 (open) adds one automatic nudge on a shape pause in `runRound` (`round.go:454-494`) and a section to `brief.go`. The nudge resumes the session, so it gets the resumed section too; whichever lands second keeps both.
- S204 (open, gate close timing at `round.go:441-464`) does not overlap in code.
- S253 (open, no spec) lists "gate stale after fixes" from S213. This slice covers that note; S253 should drop it or point here.

## Implement

1. Do not start before the owner has answered Q1 to Q5. The steps assume the recommendations; each says which answer it waits on.
2. Tests first from the failing list. Confirm each fails for the reason given.
3. Brief (Q1): add `ReadOnly bool` to `BriefInput`. When it is set, `## Your files` prints the report path line and the final-message line from the failing test instead of the plain `Your report path:` line. `runRound` sets it from `perm.ReadOnly`; `RunSpecCheck` sets it to true. Do not change the prompts or `readReport`: the result text is already saved to the report path (`round.go:578-593`).
4. Brief (Q2): add `Resumed bool` and `Tree string` to `BriefInput`. When `Resumed` is set, add the `## Resumed session` section after `## Your files`, with the body from the failing test. Fence the listing with a fence longer than any backtick run in it (the rule of `brief.go:94-105`). In `runRound`, set `Resumed: session != ""` and, when resumed, read `treeStatus` before `BuildBrief` and pass it as `Tree`; for a read-only role reuse that value as the fingerprint `before` (`round.go:293-298`) so git runs once. A `treeStatus` error pauses as `read-only fingerprint` does today.
5. Report (Q5): in `parseOwnerQuestion`, drop a line whose trimmed text is three or more backticks, optionally followed by a word (`text`, `markdown`), before the shape checks. Nothing else in `CheckReport` changes; a fence around the whole report is not unwrapped (Q5 (a)).
6. Retry note (Q3): add `Note string` to `runrec.Pending` (`json:"note,omitempty"`, comment `*proposed*`). Add `Engine.RetryNote(ctx, note string)`: it trims the note and does what `Retry` does; before `advance` it stores the note on `Pending` (or on `Pending.Retry` in the queued-question path at `engine.go:478-492`). `Retry(ctx)` calls `RetryNote(ctx, "")`. `pendingSection` appends `## Owner note` with the note for any pending kind, after the kind's own section. The note leaves the record with `Pending` when the round ends (`round.go:396-398`).
7. Daemon (Q3): `run.retry` calls `RetryNote(ctx, p.Text)`. The refusal texts stay as they are.
8. CLI (Q3): `ork retry RUN [TEXT]`. Keep the usage line within 80 columns. Keep any flag S237 adds.
9. Do not change the TUI's retry key (it sends no text), `Answer`, `Fix`, the permission modes, `latestSession`, or the resume rule.

## Open owner questions

Ask the owner before the relay starts; the spec waits on these.

Q1 How does a read-only role hand back its report? (suggested adj key `role.readonly-report`)
What the drafter traced: no read-only role can write its report path on either vendor (see Why), and the final message is the decided fallback (adj 27).
Options: (a) the final message is the report for every read-only role: the brief says so and asks for no code fence; read-only mode and the fingerprint stay (one brief line; no vendor change; the prompts keep their "write the file, else the final message" text, which the brief overrides). (b) Give the Claude read-only roles a writable report path: an allowlist of `Read`, `Grep`, `Glob`, the read-only git and check commands and `Write(REPORT_PATH)` instead of plan mode (the file route works for Claude; the `Write(PATH)` scope is not measured; it reopens adj 28's "read-only" for Claude; Codex read-only has no per-path write, so Codex still reports in chat). (c) (a), and also change the prompts' Report section for read-only roles to "Give your report as your final message" (cleaner text for the agents repo, which generates role files from them, adj 29; touches the five read-only prompts and `internal/roles/roles_test.go`).
Recommendation: (a).
Waits: Implement step 3 and `TestReadOnlyBriefSaysTheReportIsTheFinalMessage`.

Q2 What does a resumed round's brief say? (suggested adj key `roles.resume-brief`)
Options: (a) a fixed `## Resumed session` section: re-run git status and git diff, re-read cited files, do not repeat an earlier finding unchecked (no git call). (b) (a) plus ork's own `git status --porcelain` listing when the round starts (the role sees at once that files changed; one git call per resumed round, reused as the read-only fingerprint). (c) (b) only when the tree changed since that session's last round (needs a new per-role tree field in the record; quieter, more code).
Which roles: every resumed round (implementer fix rounds, the gate, retries and S243's nudge), or only the gate. S72's implementer is the case for every role.
Recommendation: (b), for every resumed round.
Waits: Implement step 4 and the resumed-section tests.

Q3 May `ork retry` carry a message? (suggested adj key `cli.retry-note`)
Options: (a) `ork retry RUN [TEXT]`: the text goes to the rerun brief as `## Owner note`, held in `pending.note` until the round ends (one optional argument; `run.retry` gains `text`). (b) let `ork answer RUN TEXT` work on any pause without a question, as a note plus a retry (no new argument; blurs answer and retry, and the daemon's "use ork retry" hint goes). (c) no message; the owner stops the run or waits for the approval card to use `ork fix` (no change; the S72 case stays without a route).
TUI: the retry key sends no text under every option; a note box in the TUI is a later item.
Recommendation: (a).
Waits: Implement steps 6 to 8 and the note tests.

Q4 Does a fresh session replace a resume? (suggested adj key `engine.resume-fresh-session`)
adj 26 (`role.resume`, decided) says resume when possible, else fresh. Options (b) and (c) change that decision, which only the owner can do.
Options: (a) keep resume as decided; Q2's section carries the change (no record change; keeps the cache and the one-pass gate context). (b) start fresh, with earlier reports in the brief, when the tree changed since the session's last round (no stale memory; costs a cold start and a per-role tree field; supersedes part of adj 26). (c) start fresh for a retry of any pause (simple rule; loses the session even when nothing changed; supersedes part of adj 26).
Recommendation: (a); revisit (b) if a resumed role still repeats a stale report after this slice.
Waits: nothing under (a); under (b) or (c) the spec needs a new step and tests, so report and stop.

Q5 Does the shape check accept a fenced owner question? (suggested adj key `role.report-fence`)
Options: (a) ignore fence-only lines inside `## Owner needed` before the strict check (fixes the case seen; small). (b) (a) plus unwrap one fence that wraps a whole final-message report (also covers a gate whose first line would be a fence; more parsing). (c) no parser change; rely on Q1's "no code fence" brief line (keeps the strict shape; a model that copies the example's fence still pauses).
Recommendation: (a).
Waits: Implement step 5 and `TestStructuredQuestionInsideAFenceIsAccepted`.
